name: Shitsuren
source:
In the beginning of the game the hero is dumped by his girlfriend he was dating and he's devastated since he did not even kiss her. He asks her to name logical reasons to break relationship. Where will his broken heart lead him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遊戲開始時，主角被女友甩了，他崩潰了——因為他甚至還沒有親過她。他要求她說出分手的合理理由。他破碎的心將把他帶向何方？

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
